verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator's own GitHub project says its mobile one-time passcode implementations support HOTP (RFC 4226) as well as TOTP, so counter-based tokens have some first-party evidence. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard, custom periods or custom digit lengths. The HOTP evidence also comes from the open-source repo, not the current app's docs. missing for 10: Steam Guard token support, custom period configuration, custom digit-length support, current-app documentation of HOTP counters, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: These implementations support the HMAC-Based One-time Password (HOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 4226 and the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238.
The Google Authenticator project includes implementations of one-time passcode generators for several mobile platforms.
